variants.definition: replicate round(0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B) into all RGB channels
use Rec.709 Y with YCbCr-style chroma coordinates; rotate centered chroma vector by +90 degrees; preserve Y exactly; use radial gamut compression toward neutral instead of RGB clipping

preserve target Rec.709 Y and geometry; apply a 2D chroma mean/covariance transfer toward a deterministic label-independent donor palette at fixed strength 0.75; use radial gamut compression toward neutral

universal_palette_donor_pool.definition: sample IDs whose role is not test in O, S, T, and ST simultaneously
universal_palette_donor_pool.selection: for each target, stable SHA256 ordering of eligible donors using target sample_id and donor sample_id; first donor from a different environment_id and different canonical video if available, otherwise first different-video donor

naturalistic_transfer.space: Rec.709 Y + two YCbCr-style chroma coordinates
naturalistic_transfer.transform: regularized 2D whitening/coloring transform from target chroma covariance to donor chroma covariance
naturalistic_transfer.luminance: target Y retained exactly before uint8 rounding
naturalistic_transfer.gamut_handling: per-pixel radial chroma compression toward neutral by deterministic binary search until RGB is in gamut

interpretation.naturalistic_counterfactual_drop: stronger evidence that chromatic cues materially influence the frozen model
